name: RAG FastAPI + Qdrant
note: Every task runs a real command. Qdrant runs in its embedded in-memory mode (QdrantClient(':memory:')), so no server is needed; embeddings use the deterministic offline fallback, so no model download. Semantic-ranking quality needs the fastembed model and is skipped inside pytest when it is absent. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Ingest, retrieve and health probe against embedded Qdrant
eval_tasks.instruction: The service must boot, chunk and index a document, retrieve it through the query endpoint, and report degraded health when the backend is unreachable.
assertions: a document is chunked and indexed with HTTP 201
retrieval returns the ingested chunk with its citation block
health is ok when the collection exists and degraded when it does not or the backend is down
the collection is created with the declared HNSW parameters and a keyword tenant index
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "healthz or ingest or plumbing or health_reports or hnsw" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Tenant isolation on every vector query
eval_tasks.instruction: A query must always be pinned to one tenant: cross-tenant chunks are never returned, a missing tenant is rejected, and a spoofed or extra filter cannot widen the scope.
assertions: tenant A never sees tenant B chunks and vice versa
queries and ingests without a tenant_id are rejected with 422
extra filters cannot widen the tenant scope
a caller-supplied tenant_id key cannot override the trusted tenant condition
caller metadata cannot overwrite document_id or text in the stored payload
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "tenant or filters or metadata_cannot" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Prompt-injection delimiting, input limits and error hygiene
eval_tasks.instruction: Retrieved text must be wrapped in delimited untrusted blocks it cannot escape, inputs must be size-bounded, the chunker must terminate, and unhandled errors must not leak internals.
assertions: each chunk sits in a delimited block and cannot close its own delimiter
document_id cannot inject markup into the block header
oversized or malformed ingest and query bodies are rejected with 422
a non-advancing chunk window is rejected instead of looping forever
unhandled errors return a generic 500 with no host, secret or traceback
a wildcard CORS origin is never honoured and unlisted origins get no allow header
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "context or delimiter or markup or oversized or chunker or embedding_dimension or unhandled or cors" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Container and configuration hardening
eval_tasks.instruction: The final image stage must run as a non-root UID and the env template must carry no credential values.
assertions: the final Dockerfile stage drops to a numeric UID >= 10000
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "non_root or env_example" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
